Cream walls with ornate panel molding, a white fireplace mantel, elegant floral arrangements, and luxurious decor fill the background. prompts.title: Monarch Muse
prompts.prompt:
Create a 2:3 vertical premium mixed-media watercolor portrait on off-white cold-pressed watercolor paper.
Use the uploaded image only as the subject reference. Keep the subject’s natural features, overall appearance, and recognizable look intact, but do not let the image turn into a generic painted character.
Show the subject in a bust-length three-quarter profile, facing slightly toward the viewer’s right, with the gaze directed softly off-camera. Keep the expression calm, warm, serene, and naturally pleasant, with a subtle gentle smile and bright relaxed eyes. The mood should feel elegant, fresh, dreamy, and refined — not sad, blank, tired, or overly serious.
Keep the face highly realistic and softly photorealistic, not fully painted, not sketch-like, and not cartoonish. The face should be the main focal point. Use soft diffused natural-looking light, similar to indirect window light, to gently illuminate the forehead, nose bridge, cheeks, lips, and jawline, with delicate depth and soft shadows. Render realistic eyes with soft catchlights, defined brows, natural lips, smooth skin transitions, and fine hair strands.
Style the hair in an elegant loose low updo / low messy bun at the nape, with a few soft tendrils framing the face and neck. Intertwine subtle rustic botanical accents in the hair — tiny dried wildflowers in muted yellow, white, and blue tones — delicate, understated, and premium.
Add several detailed Monarch butterflies with vivid orange wings, black veins, black borders, and tiny white spots. Keep them crisp, refined, and slightly dimensional. Place multiple butterflies naturally around the portrait: some resting in the hair, one near the upper-right side, and others floating around the shoulders and lower frame. Their warm orange color should stand out beautifully against the cool watercolor tones.
Create a strong mixed-media double-exposure effect where parts of the portrait dissolve into watercolor blooms. This effect must be clearly visible across selected parts of the cheek, temple, jawline, neck, shoulder, and lower clothing area — not only in the background. The watercolor should feel translucent and layered over the realistic portrait, so the subject remains clearly realistic underneath.
Use expressive watercolor washes in muted teal, seafoam green, dusty blue, soft gray, charcoal, and deep navy tones. Let the washes bloom naturally into the paper with wet-on-wet behavior, soft transparent bleeding, irregular edges, subtle blooms, and a few darker pooled edges where pigment appears to have dried. Allow the watercolor to expand organically into the negative space while keeping the face as the sharpest and most detailed focal area.
Dress the subject in a simple deep navy-blue top / blouse with a high rounded neckline and soft gathered or finely pleated texture around the shoulders and upper chest. The garment should look minimal, elegant, matte, and plain, with no collar, no buttons, no printed pattern, and no decorative embellishments. Keep the outfit close to the reference look. Let the lower portion of the top gradually dissolve into blue-gray watercolor splashes.
Preserve the contrast between hyper-detailed realism and loose abstract watercolor forms. The final artwork should feel like a luxury fine-art portrait print that combines:

photorealistic portraiture
abstract watercolor fusion
soft ethereal surrealism
crisp butterfly detailing
cool watercolor tones contrasted with vivid orange butterflies
textured watercolor paper and handcrafted mixed-media realism
Overall, the result should feel poetic, airy, elegant, and premium, with the viewer’s eye drawn first to the realistic face, then to the translucent watercolor overlays and butterflies surrounding the subject.

Fingers rounded, stylized (toy-like)

Clean white background

Smooth edges, no noise, no artifactd
Naturally hair stands visible

prompts.title: Core Red
prompts.prompt:
Create a striking, high-contrast, semi-realistic digital painting portrait blending techwear aesthetics with a cinematic, anime-influenced visual tone. The result must feel like a powerful “main character” reveal with strong visual impact, similar to a high-end AAA game cinematic character rendered in semi realistic digital painting.

ASPECT RATIO
4:5 vertical

FRAME & COMPOSITION (LOCK)
Centered tight medium close-up (lower chest to head).
Subject fills approximately ~65–85% of the frame.
Perfect vertical symmetry.
Subject positioned directly in front of a large circular element behind the head and upper torso.
🔒 The head must sit slightly above the centre of the red circle, so the circle appears slightly dominant.
🔒 Framing must feel tight, controlled, and portrait-focused (not wide, not loose).

CAMERA & ANGLE (LOCK)
Low-angle camera (subtle upward perspective).
Camera positioned below eye level, looking upward toward the subject.
🔒 Head slightly tilted upward (very subtle), chin slightly raised
Creates a strong, dominant “hero” presence
No left or right tilt, no dutch angle
Natural lens feel (50mm–85mm equivalent)
No perspective distortion

POSE (LOCK)
Body fully facing forward, perfectly centered.
Neck straight, posture upright and grounded.
🔒 Shoulders relaxed but slightly pulled back
🔒 No dynamic pose — completely still and controlled
Pose must feel like a calm power stance, not a fashion pose.

SUBJECT & FACE (ADAPTIVE IDENTITY LOCK — FIXED)
Use the reference image as the base identity.
Preserve overall facial structure and proportions (jawline, cheekbones, nose, lips, face width).
Maintain recognizable identity and likeness.
🔒 Identity must remain consistent, but adapt naturally to the cinematic style of the scene.
Face should be interpreted through the scene’s lighting, mood, and rendering style, not copied rigidly.
🔒 Do NOT redesign or change identity
🔒 Do NOT beautify or alter core facial structure
🔒 Do NOT introduce new facial features
✔ Allow slight stylistic adaptation in:
skin shading
surface detail level
lighting interaction
Face must feel like the same person, rendered in this scene — not a pasted reference, not a hyper-real photo.

EXPRESSION (CRITICAL FIX)
Confident expression with slight intensity.
🔒 Lips gently closed (no smile, no tension)
🔒 Gaze must feel direct and dominant (even behind sunglasses)
🔒 No emotional exaggeration
Expression must feel:
cool, confident, slightly intense
NOT soft, NOT friendly, NOT stylized

HAIR (NATURAL + IDENTITY-BASED)
Hair must be derived from the reference image, not redesigned.
Maintain the same hairline, direction, and natural growth pattern
Preserve real-world randomness and slight imperfections
Keep natural density and texture
🔒 Do NOT create a new hairstyle
🔒 Do NOT over-style or make it too clean
🔒 Do NOT simplify into flat or graphic shapes
Hair must feel natural and realistic, not artificially styled.

EYEWEAR
Perfectly round dark sunglasses with thin silver frames highlighted.
Subtle reflections, not overly glossy, not fully opaque.

OUTFIT (TECHWEAR STYLE
Outer: Black tactical jacket with rugged, distressed/frayed edges on shoulders, lapels and other parts
Visible hardware: subtle zipper, minimal metallic details
Inner: neck gaiter covering the neck
Fabric contrast:
outer layer structured
inner layer soft and draped

ACCESSORIES
Highlight a thin silver chain with a vertical rectangular pendant.
Clean metallic reflections, subtle and realistic.

BACKGROUND (CRITICAL RED ORB FIX)
Massive glowing red circular orb behind the subject’s head and upper torso (perfect circle).
🔒 Edges softly diffused (not sharp, not graphic)
🔒 Inner flat red (No gradient)
🔒 Clean minimal look (no texture like moon surface)
Outside the circle: deep charcoal/dark grey background with soft smoky texture.
No additional elements.

LIGHTING (HERO DEPTH + RED CONTROL)
Strong, sharp red rim lighting from the circular orb:
Crisp red highlights on edges of hair, ears, jawline, shoulders, jacket threads
Clear separation from background
🔒 Red light affects edges only, not the full face
Front lighting:
soft but directional
subtle cheekbone shadows
defined shadow under nose and lower lip
slight eye socket depth
Lighting must sculpt the face, not flatten it.

COLOR PALETTE (STRICT)
Deep black (subject)
Charcoal grey (background)
Vivid saturated red (orb + rim light)
No additional dominant colors.

STYLE & RENDERING (HARD LOCK)
High-detail cinematic digital painting with semi-realistic rendering.
🔒 NOT flat illustration
🔒 NOT vector art
🔒 NOT clean anime shading
Avoid:
cel-shading
cartoon outlines
plastic skin
controlled semi-realistic skin shading (no hyper-real pores, no photographic skin detail)
overly smooth surfaces
Shading must be dimensional with realistic light falloff.
Materials must feel real (fabric, metal, glass).

RESOLUTION
4k-8k resolution with high details

STYLE PRIORITY (CONTROL)
Cinematic realism and lighting take priority over anime influence.
Anime influence must remain subtle and only affect structure—not shading.

MOOD / VIBE
Dark, cinematic, cyberpunk, mysterious.
Strong “main character energy”.
Feels like a premium movie poster or AAA game character reveal — not a flat illustration.

prompts.title: Animated Assurance
prompts.prompt:
Create an ultra-high-detail 3D animated character portrait in a premium Disney/Pixar-inspired style, designed to feel highly appealing, expressive, and avatar-friendly.
Composition:

Medium portrait (waist-up), centered, slightly body turned one side, eye-level camera angle. Subject fills ~65–75% of the frame.
Subject:

Stylized male character with slightly chibi-influenced proportions — subtly larger head (~10–15% larger than realistic proportion) and a slightly compact, youthful body while still maintaining an adult identity. Clean facial structure, smooth but detailed skin, highly expressive large eyes (not cartoonishly oversized).
Hair & Accessories:

Neatly styled, soft-volume hair with visible strand detail. Thick matte grey rim glasses, well-fitted and premium-looking.
Outfit:

Matte black long-sleeve button-down shirt with collar and two chest pockets. Sleeves rolled to mid-forearms.

Fabric must feel premium and realistic — visible micro-texture, stitching, natural folds, soft cloth behavior, subtle specular highlights (no plastic look).
Pose (IMPORTANT):

Arms confidently crossed. Body slightly angled (~15° right) to avoid flatness. Head turned toward camera with strong, natural posture.
Expression:

Highly joyful, warm, and engaging smile — friendly and likable (avatar appeal focus), not exaggerated to the point of distortion. Eyes lively with strong emotional presence.
Background:

Pure white seamless studio background (#FFFFFF), completely clean and minimal.
Lighting:

Soft high-key studio lighting. Even facial illumination with gentle shadow depth.

Subtle rim light on left side of hair and shoulder for separation. Bright, crisp eye catchlights.
Rendering & Quality:

8K ultra-detailed render, Unreal Engine 5 / Octane quality.

PBR materials, subsurface scattering for natural skin glow, high-resolution textures, sharp focus, clean premium color grading.

Stylized realism — no AI artifacts, no over-smoothing, no plastic skin.
Aspect Ratio: 4:5
